finding.impact: A user failing before input processing had to fabricate workload metadata or abandon the first-use form
finding.prior_behavior: Installation failed and Doctor failed were valid outcomes, but input class and size were required without a truthful pre-workload value

fix.size_guidance: Enter `not reached` if installation or doctor failed before processing.
fix.workload_option: Not reached — installation or doctor failed

limitations: This fixes feedback submission, not installation or doctor runtime behavior
No user report existed at the checkpoint; the collection defect was found by path inspection
Users must still provide OS/architecture, outcome, description, and privacy confirmation
Submitted content requires human privacy review
